title: Exploiting Biased Models to De-bias Text: A Gender-Fair Rewriting Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating sequence-to-sequence rewriting models designed to convert gender-biased text (e.g., generic masculine forms) into gender-fair text. The evaluation uses Tokenised Word Error Rate (WER) against gold-standard gender-fair reference texts for English and German, as well as a human evaluation campaign where participants rated the perceived gender-fairness of the model outputs using a Likert scale.
